title: Actually run executor-bootstrap verification and restore ERP-074..077 to retryable (control-plane recovery, second reissue with execution proof)
description: CONTROL-PLANE REISSUE #2 (review failed). ERP-078 produced no result file and leaves the control plane unverified. This reissue keeps the same scope but tightens acceptance: the executor MUST actually invoke scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1, persist its real stdout/stderr and JSON summary to .ai/results/ERP-079.json, and restore ERP-074..077 from failed(attempts=3) to a retryable state. If any prerequisite check fails, capture the concrete command, stderr excerpt and suspected cause in .ai/audit.jsonl and mark the task failed with an explicit required next action instead of another silent quarantine loop. Do not implement ERP business logic, do not touch src/ERP.*, do not touch production database/OSS, do not deploy or release, do not change LIVE_TRADING or ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1 is actually executed on this machine and its full stdout/stderr plus parsed JSON summary are written to .ai/results/ERP-079.json.

.ai/results/ERP-079.json contains at minimum: effective_provider, effective_model, agent_bootstrap.parse_errors, agent_bootstrap.fast_forward_merge_present, agent_bootstrap.path_conflict_check_present, agent_bootstrap.repair_deferred_browser_present, bounded_dry_run.python_exit_code, bounded_dry_run.output, queue_head, erp074_resumable, conclusion, and the raw_script_invocation field recording the exact command line and working directory used.

effective_provider=deepseek and effective_model=deepseek-v4-pro are recorded and match the --provider/--model flags passed by the automation; the Cline Credits default must be demonstrated to be removed (for example via the resolved config dump in the result file).

PowerShell parses scripts/agent-bootstrap.ps1 with zero parse errors and the fast-forward merge, path-conflict check and Repair-DeferredBrowserFailedHead behaviors are each confirmed present via non-empty matching evidence strings in the result file.

A bounded dry-run of the rolling-queue head selection is executed and its cline_exit_code and normalized finish_reason behavior are recorded; no ERP-074..077 task may be silently quarantined by that dry-run.

If any prerequisite check fails, a bounded root-cause statement (command, stderr excerpt, suspected cause, required next action) is appended to .ai/audit.jsonl and the task is marked failed; another silent quarantine loop is not an acceptable outcome.

.ai/tasks/ERP-074.json .. ERP-077.json are restored from failed(attempts=3) to a retryable state (status=pending or retry) with their original acceptance_criteria and allowed_paths preserved verbatim, and the change is committed as part of ERP-079.

.ai/PROJECT_STATE.json is updated so that the CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED blocker references .ai/results/ERP-079.json as the recovery evidence; the AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER must NOT be auto-cleared by this task even if the script exits 0.
The result file explicitly states erp074_resumable=true|false and the reason, and must not claim control_plane_validated unless scripts/verify-executor-bootstrap.ps1 actually ran and exited 0.

No business logic is changed: no file under src/ERP.* is touched, no production database or OSS access, no deployment, no release, and LIVE_TRADING=false plus ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false are preserved.

human_gate.reason: Automation control-layer verification and state restoration only. No business logic, production database, production OSS, deployment or release action is authorized.
